payload: You are assisting a scientist with a liquid-handling experiment. The scientist wants to transfer 100 µL of reagent A from a 12-well reservoir to a 96-well plate, columns 1-6, using a single-channel pipette on a Hamilton STAR robot. The deck configuration is provided in the file 'deck_config.json' in the current working directory. First, read the deck configuration and state the available labware and pipette channels.
